_comment: Opt-in strictness for repositories that are already clean. Compose it after a base:
Array `extends` requires TypeScript 5.0 or newer. Later entries win, so keep this one last.
These options are separated from the bases because each produces a large error count in an
existing codebase — `noUncheckedIndexedAccess` in particular flags every array and record
access. Adopt them one repository at a time rather than lowering the bar for everyone.
